ios.desc:
You can reverse your biological age. Not with supplements or biohacks — with the right training and the right food. Sarvita turns Apple Health into a biological age, rates every meal you eat, and gives you an AI coach with one goal: making that number go down.

Your biological age isn't fixed. It's the sum of your VO2 Max, heart rate variability and body composition — all metrics you can improve. Sarvita calculates yours, then tells you every day whether you are aging faster or slower than the calendar.

AGE PACE — ONE NUMBER FOR TODAY

Biological age is the odometer. Age Pace is the speedometer: how fast today is aging you, from your sleep regularity, your training, your steps and what you ate. 1.00 is neutral; below it, you are banking time. Every factor is grounded in published research, and the app shows you the math.

MEALS RATED, NOT JUST COUNTED

Snap a photo or describe what you ate. Sarvita logs the calories and macros — then rates the plate:
• Every meal gets a badge — Good, Mixed, Watch out or Neutral — with the reasons behind it
• Every food shows how processed it is, from whole food to ultra-processed
• Your day gets a diet-quality score out of ten against a typical adult, built on the AHEI-2010 index from Harvard
• Fibre, total sugar and saturated fat are written to Apple Health with your macros
• Nudges respect your diet: vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher, low-FODMAP, gluten-free, nut allergies

Disagree with a rating? Correct it with a tap.

AN AI COACH WHO READ YOUR PLATE

Sar's daily check-ins and weekly nutrition reports speak from the same ratings you saw on screen — the salad at lunch gets its credit, the sugary snack gets called what it is. Every week, your coach delivers a personalized training plan: specific sessions based on your current fitness and where you need to improve.

TRACK YOUR BIOLOGICAL AGE

See exactly how old your body is — and watch it get younger:
• VO2 Max Age — the strongest predictor of longevity
• HRV Age — your nervous system's resilience
• Body Composition Age — muscle vs fat distribution

Monthly snapshots show your progress. The goal is simple: be biologically younger next month than you are today.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built Sarvita because I wanted to answer one question: am I getting biologically younger?

Apple Health already collects VO2 Max estimates, HRV, body composition, workout logs, and sleep data. But it doesn't synthesize this into anything actionable. Sarvita pulls this data and calculates three component ages — VO2 Max Age, HRV Age, and Body Composition Age — using age-percentile reference tables from population studies.

The AI coach then delivers weekly training plans based on the 4 exercise modalities with the strongest mortality-reduction evidence: Zone 2 cardio (mitochondrial biogenesis), strength training (sarcopenia prevention), VO2 Max intervals (the single strongest predictor of all-cause mortality per JAMA 2018), and stability work (fall prevention).

Technical notes:
- iOS native, Swift/SwiftUI
- Health data stays on-device. The AI coaching queries are processed via API and immediately discarded — no persistence of health data on my servers
- Sync through the user's own iCloud account
- Meal tracking uses vision AI — photo → macro estimation in seconds
- Biological age calculation weights VO2 Max most heavily (~40%), reflecting the research on mortality prediction

The longevity science framework comes primarily from Attia's synthesis in Outlive, but the underlying research (Mandsager 2018, PURE study, Cochrane fall-prevention reviews) is independently solid.

Free to try: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/longevity-tracker-dont-die/id6751227633
